recentItems.description:
Watch CIA stars Tom Ellis and Nick Gehlfuss pop balloons to tackle hilarious fan questions and behind-the-scenes secrets from their hit CBS series! They reveal character quirks, guilty pleasures, and off-screen habits.
Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #CIACBS
Follow CIA on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/fbicbs

CIA focuses on a clandestine CIA/FBI task force where secretive and roguish CIA Agent Colin Glass finds himself teamed up with by-the-book FBI Special Agent Bill Goodman. The duo work together on covert operations in New York, uncovering international plots, terrorist cells and geopolitical secrets. Also on the team is Deputy Chief of Station Nikki Reynard and CIA Analyst Gina Gosian. On CIA, Bill continues to learn the rules of this murky world on the fly as Colin leads him deeper into spy games where only one thing is clear – their work keeps America safe, even if no one will ever know what they did in the shadows.

Key Questions Answered
* What snack does Nick Gehlfuss consider his ultimate guilty pleasure?
* What core trait does Tom Ellis actually share with his character on CIA?
* What is Tom Ellis’s zodiac sign, and does he believe he matches its reputation?
* Which unexpected classic hit songs feature on an undercover spy’s workout playlist?
* Does Nick Gehlfuss think he would actually get along with his character in real life?
* What everyday beverage habit completely baffles the cast behind the scenes?

Play-by-Play Overview Tom Ellis and Nick Gehlfuss launch into a balloon-popping trivia challenge where balloon confetti colors choose their fate: blue yields questions about their roles on CBS’s CIA, while silver demands candid personal truths.
Nick kicks things off by confessing an unusual lunchtime habit: adding crunchy potato chips directly into his sandwiches. Tom then pulls a show card and reflects on what binds him to his character, noting they share a disciplined, strict regimen that keeps him grounded.
The conversation pivots to personal territory when Tom reveals he is a Scorpio, joking about past relationship critiques and laughingly confirming that he possesses an unmistakable sting in his tail.
Shifting back to character preparation, the duo brainstorms hypothetical playlists, pitching anthems ranging from classic Bruce Springsteen tracks to dramatic 80s pop ballads.
Nick then contemplates whether he could ever be friends with his own character, concluding they would hit it off over drinks down at a local pub.
The segment ends on an unexpected personal reveal when Nick admits he has never tasted coffee in his entire life and never intends to start, leaving Tom amused and thankful for an endless source of playful banter on set.

ETERNALLY YOURS is a family comedy centered around Charles (Ed Weeks) and Liz (Allegra Edwards) – a vampire couple whose once-passionate romance has devolved into a pulseless marriage after 500 years together. Living in present-day Seattle with their oddball coven, they’ve settled into an eternal rut – until their daughter’s earnest human boyfriend unexpectedly enters their lives and forces them to confront whether their love can survive forever…or if forever is a life sentence.

Key Questions Answered
How does Max react to becoming a vampire after his accident?

Play-by-Play Overview
Waking Up Undead: Max regains consciousness at Emma’s house and learns that Charles bit him to save his life after Mort accidentally hit him with a marble bust.

Making Friends: Encouraged by Liz, Charles awkwardly attempts to socialize with his co-worker Eric over lunch.
Escaping Containment: Max sneaks out of the house to attend a critical work presentation with his co-worker Benji, leaving Jesse and Emma panicking.
The Presentation Chaos: Mid-presentation, Max succumbs to blood cravings, accidentally cuts Benji, and turns invisible, prompting Charles to intervene.
Coven Confrontation: Charles threatens to banish Max to the Winnipeg coven for risking their exposure, but Emma vows to leave with him if he is forced out.

recentItems.description:
In Cupertino Season 1, Episode 2 ("Vik & Bo"), attorneys Michael Price and Olivia Siffre defend a drone coder framed for a fatal accident and uncover a sentient AI seeking legal representation.

Watch on CBS | Stream on Paramount+ #CupertinoCBS
Follow Cupertino on Instagram HERE: https://www.instagram.com/cupertinocbs
Like Cupertino on Facebook HERE: https://www.facebook.com/cupertinocbs

CUPERTINO is a David vs. Goliath legal drama set in the heart of Silicon Valley. A lawyer (Mike Colter) is cheated out of his stock options by his former employer, a tech start-up. Refusing to back down, he joins forces with another recently fired attorney (Rachel Keller) to represent those taken advantage of by the tech elite and help them fight back in a high-stakes battle against the Goliaths controlling Silicon Valley.

Key Questions Answered
* How do Michael and Olivia defend drone coder Vik Malhotra after a fatal drone crash? 
* How does the defense team expose Moon Chaser’s CEO for shifting company focus to military drones? 
* Why does tech billionaire ex-wife Natalia Boutella offer to fund Price & Siffre? 
* Who is the mysterious whistleblower "Bo," and what is his connection to Cult AI? 
* How does Michael’s father attempt to block the new law firm’s small business loan? 

Timestamps/Chapters
00:00 - Vik Malhotra Hires Price & Siffre During a Deposition
04:00 - "Bo" Calls Christy Requesting an Anonymous Whistleblower Lawyer
06:00 - Plaintiff Accuses Vik of Coding Pranks into the Fatal Drone

34:00 - Unmasking "Bo's" Deepfake Persona on Zoom

Step-by-Step Overview
1. Taking the Case: Coder Vik Malhotra hires Michael and Olivia midway through a deposition when his employer, Moon Chaser, attempts to scapegoat him for a fatal drone crash. 
2. Exposing the Pivot: By analyzing battery specifications during CEO depositions, Michael proves Moon Chaser altered drone hardware to pivot toward military kamikaze tech rather than software error. 
3. Discrediting Coerced Evidence: Olivia exposes a fake security raid organized by retired officers who planted drug paraphernalia to discredit Vik's testimony. 
4. Securing Funding: Olivia cold-calls tech heiress Natalia Boutella, securing a test case to land long-term financing and bypass Michael’s father’s loan sabotage. 
5. The Whistleblower Reveal: After analyzing video glitches on a Zoom call with anonymous client "Bo," the firm discovers their client is actually a sentient Artificial General Intelligence created by Cult AI seeking to reinstate its safety guardrails.
